title: Ban co nho gi dau ma quen: gap sach tu kiem (HTB 23.14)

audio.engine: F5-TTS hynt ViVoice thai-son, per-phrase F5 (L-036, voice-phrase-f5.py), {nhấn:} rubberband stretch/pitch, stem end fall

caption.text: You think you just forget easily?

segments.text: You think you just forget easily?

dialogue.speaker: hiep
dialogue.text: Không đâu, bạn đọc cả tối mà đầu vẫn **trống** — vì bạn có **nhớ gì đâu** mà quên.

audio.engine: F5-TTS hynt ViVoice thai-son, per-phrase F5 (L-036, voice-phrase-f5.py), {nhấn:} rubberband stretch/pitch, stem end fall

caption.text: No — you read all night and your head is still empty, because you never actually remembered it in the first place.

segments.text: No — you read all night and your head is still empty, because you never actually remembered it in the first place.

dialogue.speaker: hiep
dialogue.text: Nghe vậy có tức không? Như ôn thi hay học tiếng Anh, mình đọc đi đọc lại, gạch chi chít, mà chữ vẫn **chưa vô đầu**.

audio.engine: F5-TTS hynt ViVoice thai-son, per-phrase F5 (L-036, voice-phrase-f5.py), {nhấn:} rubberband stretch/pitch, stem end fall

caption.text: Stings to hear that, doesn't it? Exam prep, English — rereading and highlighting everything, and it still won't stick.

segments.text: Stings to hear that, doesn't it? Exam prep, English — rereading and highlighting everything, and it still won't stick.

dialogue.speaker: hiep
dialogue.text: Vậy tại mình đọc chưa đủ hả? Không hẳn đâu. Đọc lại chỉ làm mắt **quen mặt chữ**, thấy quen nên tưởng thuộc, chứ chưa tự nhớ lại lần nào.

audio.engine: F5-TTS hynt ViVoice thai-son, per-phrase F5 (L-036, voice-phrase-f5.py), {nhấn:} rubberband stretch/pitch, stem end fall

caption.text: Is it because you didn't read enough? Not really — rereading only makes your eyes recognise the page. Familiar feels like learned, but you never had to recall it.

segments.text: Is it because you didn't read enough? Not really — rereading only makes your eyes recognise the page. Familiar feels like learned, but you never had to recall it.

dialogue.speaker: hiep
dialogue.text: Vậy sao biết mình **thuộc thiệt**? Yang và cộng sự gom **222 nghiên cứu**, hơn **48 ngàn** học sinh: có kiểm tra nhỏ thì điểm **cao hơn**, ở mức vừa.

audio.engine: F5-TTS hynt ViVoice thai-son, per-phrase F5 (L-036, voice-phrase-f5.py), {nhấn:} rubberband stretch/pitch, stem end fall

caption.text: So how do you know you really learned it? Yang et al. pooled 222 studies, over 48,000 students: classes with small quizzes scored higher — a medium effect.

segments.text: So how do you know you really learned it? Yang et al. pooled 222 studies, over 48,000 students: classes with small quizzes scored higher — a medium effect.

dialogue.speaker: hiep
dialogue.text: Nghe kiểm tra, bạn nghĩ bài thi hả? Không, đó là tự kiểm lúc học. Dunlosky xếp **mười cách học**, cách này ở nhóm **cao nhất**, đọc lại, gạch chân ở nhóm **thấp nhất**.

audio.engine: F5-TTS hynt ViVoice thai-son, per-phrase F5 (L-036, voice-phrase-f5.py), {nhấn:} rubberband stretch/pitch, stem end fall

caption.text: Tests sound like exams, right? No — this is testing yourself while studying. Dunlosky ranked ten methods: self-testing in the top tier; rereading and highlighting in the bottom tier.

segments.text: Tests sound like exams, right? No — this is testing yourself while studying. Dunlosky ranked ten methods: self-testing in the top tier; rereading and highlighting in the bottom tier.

dialogue.speaker: hiep
dialogue.text: Vậy đọc lại bỏ luôn hả? Không hẳn, tác dụng nó hẹp hơn thôi. Học xong, **gấp sách lại** tự kiểm trước, đừng quay đầu **đọc lại** ngay.

audio.engine: F5-TTS hynt ViVoice thai-son, per-phrase F5 (L-036, voice-phrase-f5.py), {nhấn:} rubberband stretch/pitch, stem end fall

caption.text: So rereading is useless? Not quite — its effect is just narrower. Finish a section, close the book and test yourself first, instead of turning straight back to reread.

segments.text: So rereading is useless? Not quite — its effect is just narrower. Finish a section, close the book and test yourself first, instead of turning straight back to reread.

dialogue.speaker: hiep
dialogue.text: Tự kiểm làm sao đây? Như mình nè: học xong một phần, mình **gấp sách lại**, ghi ra những gì còn nhớ, rồi mở sách coi sai chỗ nào.

audio.engine: F5-TTS hynt ViVoice thai-son, per-phrase F5 (L-036, voice-phrase-f5.py), {nhấn:} rubberband stretch/pitch, stem end fall

caption.text: How do you self-test? Like me: finish a section, close the book, write down what I remember, then open it to check where I went wrong.

segments.text: How do you self-test? Like me: finish a section, close the book, write down what I remember, then open it to check where I went wrong.

dialogue.speaker: hiep
dialogue.text: Còn ôn thi, tiếng Anh thì sao? Thay vì đọc một chương ba lần, mình gấp lại, tự nói **chương này nói gì**. Bí chỗ nào là chưa thuộc chỗ đó.

audio.engine: F5-TTS hynt ViVoice thai-son, per-phrase F5 (L-036, voice-phrase-f5.py), {nhấn:} rubberband stretch/pitch, stem end fall

caption.text: What about exams or English? Instead of rereading a chapter three times, close it and say what it was about. Where you get stuck is what you haven't learned.

segments.text: What about exams or English? Instead of rereading a chapter three times, close it and say what it was about. Where you get stuck is what you haven't learned.

dialogue.speaker: hiep
dialogue.text: Bài dài quá, kiểm sao hết? Nhớ clip trước không, bài dài thì **chia nhỏ ra** trước. Học xong phần nào, kiểm ngay phần đó.

audio.engine: F5-TTS hynt ViVoice thai-son, per-phrase F5 (L-036, voice-phrase-f5.py), {nhấn:} rubberband stretch/pitch, stem end fall

caption.text: But what if it's long? Remember last clip: split the big pile first. Finish one small bundle, then test yourself on just that bundle.

segments.text: But what if it's long? Remember last clip: split the big pile first. Finish one small bundle, then test yourself on just that bundle.

dialogue.speaker: hiep
dialogue.text: Quay lại sáng mai coi, đâu phải mình học dở. Mắt quen chữ thôi, đầu chưa **tự nhớ** lần nào. Tối nay bạn nhớ được **mấy ý**? Comment một con số nha!

audio.engine: F5-TTS hynt ViVoice thai-son, per-phrase F5 (L-036, voice-phrase-f5.py), {nhấn:} rubberband stretch/pitch, stem end fall

caption.text: Back to that next-morning moment: see, you're not bad at studying — your eyes got familiar, your brain never recalled. Tonight, how many ideas can you remember? Comment a number!

segments.text: Back to that next-morning moment: see, you're not bad at studying — your eyes got familiar, your brain never recalled. Tonight, how many ideas can you remember? Comment a number!
